subject: Supplier onboarding: address correction + bank update + duplicate VID flag
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Miranda Soto <miranda@intego-logistics.com>, Intego Logistics AP <ap@intego-logistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: address correction + bank update + duplicate VID flag

Hi Miranda,

Thanks for signing our onboarding packet earlier this week. A couple items flagged by ProcOps as we create your supplier record:

1) Address mismatch: the business address on page 2 of your onboarding form ("501 Cypress Ave, Suite 3") does not match the address we have in the vendor lookup ("510 Cypress Ave"). Please confirm the correct remit and location addresses for invoice routing vs. shipments.

2) Duplicate supplier: our vendor search returned two legacy VIDs that look like Intego entries: VID-00452 and VID-02109. We need your confirmation which record we should keep (and any aliases) to avoid duplicate payments. If one is obsolete, let us know which one we should mark inactive.

3) Banking update: You attached a bank letter but we need either a voided cheque or bank verification letter on company letterhead for ACH setup. For security we require the letter to be dated within the last 90 days and include the account holder name and last 4 digits.

Can you: 1) confirm correct address(es), 2) tell us whether to keep VID-00452 or VID-02109 (or provide the correct VID if different), and 3) attach a voided cheque or bank letter?

Next steps on our side once we have these: ProcOps will merge/flag duplicate records, update remit/billing addresses, and queue VID for ACH enablement — PO routing will follow standard 7-day window after vendor enablement. If you need a faster PO or an interim payment, let us know and we can request an exception from Finance.

Thanks — copying Monica from ProcOps to help with the merge and Laura for final approvals on deactivations.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Attachment: intego_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Miranda Soto <miranda@intego-logistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Intego Logistics AP <ap@intego-logistics.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: address correction + bank update + duplicate VID flag

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note.

Quick answers below and attaching the documents:

- Address: Our official legal & remit address is 501 Cypress Ave, Suite 3, San Mateo, CA 94401. 510 Cypress is an old shipping hub we closed in 2024. Please use 501 Cypress for both remit and legal.

- Duplicate VID: We were set up twice during the acquisition of NorthWest Freight. The active account is VID-02109 (the newer record) — VID-00452 should be deprecated. Please keep 02109 as the primary.

- Banking: Attached a voided cheque image and a bank verification letter dated 2026-03-22. Let me know if you need the bank to complete a third-party verification form.

We want POs routed to ap@intego-logistics.com. Net terms: standard 45 days as agreed in the SOW.

Best,
Miranda
Director, Finance Ops
Intego Logistics
miranda@intego-logistics.com

Attachments: intego_voided_cheque.jpg (image/jpeg), bank_verification_letter.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding: address correction + bank update + duplicate VID flag

Forwarding Miranda's confirmation and attachments.

Monica — can you:
- Deactivate VID-00452 and merge any outstanding POs or invoices onto VID-02109? Please check the prior_vendor_lookup.csv I pulled from our vendor index and flag any orphaned invoices.
- Update remit address to 501 Cypress Ave, Suite 3, San Mateo, CA 94401 for VID-02109.
- Attach the voided cheque/bank letter to Workday vendor VID-02109 and set status to ACH-pending verification.

Laura — we should be able to cleanly deactivate 00452, but if there are blocked invoices older than 90 days I'll need approval to issue a one-off manual payment or set a short-term exception.

I'll add a JIRA ticket (PROC-4781) and the Drive link for the onboarding packet.

Thanks — deadline: could we complete the merge and ACH enablement by EOD Wed (4/15)? That keeps the first PO on schedule for next week.

--
Karthik

Attachment: prior_vendor_lookup.csv (text/csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Supplier onboarding: address correction + bank update + duplicate VID flag

Thanks for the summary.

Monica — approve the merge/deactivation of VID-00452 into VID-02109. Please follow these rules:
- Preserve transaction history for both VIDs; do not delete audit notes.
- Mark VID-00452 as "inactive - merged" and add a parent alias linking it to VID-02109.
- If you find any open invoices tied to 00452, escalate to me before issuing an exception; we should avoid manual payments unless absolutely necessary.

Karthik — good to proceed with ACH verification once the voided cheque is uploaded (ProcOps to mark as ACH-pending). If everything is clean, authorize ProcOps to enable POs for VID-02109 and route POs to ap@intego-logistics.com.

One more ask: Monica, confirm once the Workday record shows the new remit address and that VID-02109 is the active payee. I will close PROC-4781 after your confirmation.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
